about.title: Firebaugh Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Firebaugh is a small town. With roughly 8,330 residents in Fresno County, a death here is never anonymous; neighbors notice, and the loss carries into classrooms, churches, and workplaces. Public collision records for 2025 list one injury crash in the city and no traffic fatalities, which is a fact worth noting. Still, wrongful death claims are not limited to what happens on the road. An unsafe workplace, a defective piece of equipment, a missed diagnosis, or a collision on Rt 33 or N Dos Palos Road can all leave a family asking whether another person's carelessness cost a life. California gives certain relatives the right to answer that question in civil court: a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a government entity is involved. LawProactive does not handle the claim itself. We connect Firebaugh families, at no cost, with an independent attorney who does, working on contingency.

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, then extending to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can tell you plainly whether your relationship qualifies.

items.title: Deadlines Explained Early
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file, and considerably less time if a city, county, or state agency may be responsible. Getting connected sooner protects your family's choices.

items.title: No Fee Unless There's a Recovery

items.question: Firebaugh recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death claims don't happen here?
items.answer: Not at all. Traffic is only one source of these claims, and Firebaugh's economy involves farm equipment, packing operations, and long drives on roads like Rt 33 and Clyde Fannon Road toward neighboring communities. A death caused by negligence anywhere, whether at work, in a medical setting, or on a highway outside city limits, may still support a claim brought by a Firebaugh family.

items.question: The person responsible is facing criminal charges. Do we still need a civil case?
items.answer: A criminal prosecution is brought by the district attorney to punish the accused, and it does not compensate your family. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action that seeks recovery for funeral and burial expenses, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. The two can proceed at the same time, and the outcome of one does not decide the other.

items.question: How does LawProactive work, and what will it cost us?
